chunks: Whoever takes payment for teaching the Qur'an, that will be his share on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, the revealed Book of Allah
key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about taking payment for teaching the Qur'an?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warns against taking material payment for teaching the Qur'an. The hadith links such compensation to one's outcome in the hereafter, emphasizing sincerity and the grave spiritual weight of teaching divine revelation.
